headline: Portugal's Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel said Pakistan has Portugal's full support for the EU's GSP+ status, and the two countries agreed to set up a Joint Ministerial Commission during talks with Ishaq Dar in Islamabad, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Pakistan and Portugal to set up joint ministerial commission

caption:
Portugal pledges 'full support' for Pakistan's GSP+ status! 🇵🇰🇵🇹
According to Dawn, Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel said on Monday that Pakistan has Portugal's full support for the European Union's GSP+ status, during delegation-level talks in Islamabad with Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar. The two ministers agreed to set up a Pakistan-Portugal Joint Ministerial Commission to boost trade and investment. Pakistan's current GSP+ status runs until 2027, and Rangel said this was the first visit to Pakistan by a Portuguese delegation in 19 years.
